body.statement: SPEC-3-28: Verdicts kept across processes are their owner's, outside every store: each entry carries a MAC, over its key, its verdict and the identity of the code that computed it, under a secret only the owner reads; an entry that does not verify is ignored, and no snapshot, digest or handoff includes them.
